-- Spec: append a copy of s to the borrowed list dst, in place.

appended(xs: List[str], s: str) -> List[str] =
  post out.len() == xs.len() + 1
  ex appended([], "a") == ["a"]
  var out: List[str] = []
  for x in xs
    out.append(copy x)
  out.append(copy s)
  out

add_name(var dst: List[str], s: str) =
  pre s.char_count() >= 0
  post dst.len() >= 1
  ex add_name(&names, "a")
  dst.append(copy s)
